name: dsh-plugin-flow-tracer
description: DSH flow visualizer plugin: collect runtime events and stream them to a local viewer

scripts.build:client: esbuild src/client/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --jsx=automatic --outfile=lib/client.js --external:react --external:react/jsx-runtime --external:react-dom --external:react-dom/client --external:@deepseek-ai/cordis --external:@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots --external:@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives --banner:js='window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: "dsh-plugin-flow-tracer", factory: (require) => { var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;' --footer:js='return module.exports; } });'
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:client && npm run build:viewer
